import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
	public static void main(String args[]) {
		Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = s.nextInt();
		String inp = s.next();
		int maxl = -1, curl = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			if (inp.charAt(i) == '_') {
				if (curl > maxl) maxl = curl;
				curl = 0;
				continue;
			} else if (inp.charAt(i) != '(' && inp.charAt(i) != ')') {
				curl++;
			} else {
				if (curl > maxl) maxl = curl;
				curl = 0;
				i++;
				while (inp.charAt(i) != ')') i++;
			}
		}
		if (curl > maxl) maxl = curl;
		int numwrd = 0;
		curl = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			while (i < n && inp.charAt(i) != '(') i++;
			if (i == n) break;
			i++;
			while (inp.charAt(i) != ')') {
				if (inp.charAt(i) == '_') {
					if (curl > 0) numwrd++;
					curl = 0;
				} else if (inp.charAt(i) != '_') {
					curl++;
				}
				i++;
			}
			if (curl > 0) numwrd++;
			curl = 0;
		}
		System.out.println(maxl + " " + numwrd);
	}
}
